This cocktail bar is a delight. Get in there meet the staff and try the cocktails
Mar 2025 • Couples
Where do I start? First of all it’s hard to find, but do yourself a favour and look for it. The outdoor balcony overlooks Ben Thanh market. The staff are just the most beautiful people I’ve ever met in a bar. Fluent English. They are very proud of 1914 and the cocktails they serve. The cocktails maybe on the pricey side but let me tell you they are 100% worth it. The cocktail are a representation of Vietnamese food in the form of a drink. For example I had one that was flavour to resemble the Vietnamese pound cake, also one that was like beef noodle??? Sounds weird but they were amazing.
